summary: U.S. forces began a new wave of strikes against Iran at 2 p.m. ET today, the sixth consecutive night of operations to degrade Iranian military capabilities. Israeli strikes killed two Hamas commanders in Gaza, including an October 7 platoon commander. Iranian-aligned actors threatened to close the Bab al-Mandeb Strait if U.S. attacks on Iranian power stations continue.
key_points: U.S. forces began a new wave of strikes against Iran at 2 p.m. ET today, the sixth consecutive night of operations to degrade Iranian military capabilities per CENTCOM. (Source: @shin_persian/7983)
The IDF killed Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq, a Hamas Shati Battalion platoon commander who invaded Israel on October 7, in an airstrike in northern Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/58797)
An Israeli strike in central Gaza killed Omar Ahmed Abu Qasem, a Hamas sniper commander who advanced attacks in violation of the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @almogboker78/17724)
Explosions were reported in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, with a sixth blast recorded, and in Qeshm island and Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province, Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/7990)
Houthis completed preparations to attack ships with missiles and drones at Bab al-Mandeb, with Iranian Revolutionary Guards in Yemen to decide on closing the strait. (Source: @asafroz/51524)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz spoke with U.S. Secretary of War Hegseth on U.S. operations in Iran and pledged to keep security zones in Syria, Gaza, Lebanon. (Source: @almogboker78/17723)
Lebanon's south saw 88 alerts, 74 drone sightings, and 3 drone strikes plus 2 air raids and 5 artillery shellings on July 16 per daily tally. (Source: @redlinkleb/31566)
A U.S. MQ-9 drone flying over Khuzestan was downed by Iranian air defense according to uncensored field security news. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93631)

sections.executive_summary: U.S. forces began a new wave of strikes against Iran at 2 p.m. ET today, the sixth consecutive night of operations to degrade Iranian military capabilities. Israeli strikes killed two Hamas commanders in Gaza, including an October 7 platoon commander in northern Gaza and a sniper commander in central Gaza. Iranian forces and proxies escalated with explosions across Khuzestan and Hormozgan, Houthis preparing to close Bab al-Mandeb, and threats of new fronts from Iran.

points: U.S. forces began a new wave of strikes against Iran at 2 p.m. ET today, the sixth consecutive night of operations to further degrade Iranian military capabilities, U.S. Central Command says. (Source: @shin_persian/7983)

Explosions occurred in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, with a source reporting two terrible back-to-back blasts at 22:35 and later seven or eight more bombings; a sixth blast was reported in Ahvaz. (Source: @mamlekate/103912)

Explosions were reported in Qeshm island and Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province; Bandar Abbas also saw fighter jet sounds and four heavy explosions at 11 p.m. with nearby power cuts. (Source: @shin_persian/7988)
U.S. attack on a residential neighborhood in Bandar Abbas martyred at least one civilian and injured seven others per Press TV. (Source: @presstv/199059)
In Hormozgan, Kuharestan and Gariyeh bridges were hit by U.S. air attacks; two killed and four wounded; Bandar Abbas-Lar and Kashar-Kuharestan roads blocked. (Source: @VahidOnline/77167)
An MQ-9 American drone flying over Khuzestan was downed by Iranian air defense systems according to uncensored field security news. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93631)
Iran's army spokesperson stated any continued hostile action against the state will bring a response exceeding enemy expectations and create new confrontation arenas. (Source: @almogboker78/17725)

The IDF killed Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq, a platoon commander in Hamas's Shati Battalion who participated in the October 7 onslaught, in an airstrike in northern Gaza Strip. (Source: @manniefabian/58797)

An Israeli strike in central Gaza yesterday killed Omar Ahmed Abu Qasem, a Hamas sniper commander who took part in attacks on troops and violated the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @manniefabian/58794)

Defense Minister Israel Katz spoke with U.S. Secretary of War Hegseth; they agreed to continue cooperation and Israel will remain in security zones in Syria, Gaza, Lebanon. (Source: @inon_yttach/9493)
Col. Elad Tzuri entered command of the 99th 'Bazak' Division per IDF announcement. (Source: @idf_telegram/24655)
Brigade 769 trained battalions that served in Gaza for northern border deployment with terrorist infiltration, casualty evacuation, and settlement defense scenarios. (Source: @idf_telegram/24652)

Security forces arrested activists managing the 'Union of Health Committees' institution in Ramallah, part of the Popular Front's financial mechanism, with indictments filed. (Source: @inon_yttach/9504)
Naval commander Maj. Gen. Eyal Harel commemorated Shayetet 13 fallen, noting commandos operated in varied missions since the October 7 black Sabbath 1000 days ago. (Source: @inon_yttach/9503)
The IDF eliminated a Hamas department commander who infiltrated Israel on October 7 in the Gaza Strip today per Yedioth report. (Source: @yediotnews25/132797)
Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq, a Hamas Shati Battalion platoon commander who invaded Israel on October 7 and trained terrorists, was killed in northern Gaza airstrike. (Source: @manniefabian/58797)
Omar Ahmed Abu Qasem, a Hamas sniper commander in central Gaza, was killed yesterday; he advanced terror plots against IDF forces violating the ceasefire. (Source: @almogboker78/17724)

In the West Bank, security forces arrested several activists involved in managing the 'Union of Health Committees' institution tied to the Popular Front terror financing in Ramallah. (Source: @inon_yttach/9504)
The IDF in recent months ramped up strikes on terror operatives in Gaza including numerous October 7 terrorists said to threaten Israeli forces. (Source: @manniefabian/58797)
No additional specific Gaza or West Bank operational facts beyond the above commander killings and West Bank arrest raids were explicitly stated in messages. (Source: @yediotnews25/132797)
Warplanes flew toward southern Lebanon with maximum caution urged per Red Link Lebanon alert. (Source: @redlinkleb/31568)
Artillery shelling reported on Hula in southern Lebanon per live map notification. (Source: @redlinkleb/31557)
Daily tally for July 16: 88 total alerts, 74 drone sightings; Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Kfar Tibnit each 13 sightings; 3 drone strikes; 2 air raids; 5 artillery shellings. (Source: @redlinkleb/31566)

Most active districts were Nabatieh (30), Bint Jbeil (23), Tyre (10); drone strikes on Ali al-Tahir, Mifdoun, Kfar Tibnit; air raids on Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Braashit, Beit Yahoun. (Source: @redlinkleb/31566)
An explosion heard in the south was an enemy detonation in Zawtar al-Sharqiya per Red Link Lebanon note. (Source: @redlinkleb/31542)
Warplanes attacked the town of al-Mansouri per Iraqi border monitoring channel. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378060)
Israeli Defense Minister referenced commitment to remain in security zones in Lebanon against jihadist threats as lesson from October 7. (Source: @almogboker78/17723)

Syrian army seized a huge weapons smuggling shipment destined for Hezbollah including about 150 explosive drones, long-range missiles, and anti-tank missiles at Syria-Iraq border. (Source: @inon_yttach/9499)
The seized weapons were hidden in oil tankers and were en route to Lebanon when caught by Syrian forces. (Source: @inon_yttach/9499)
Iraqi security forces clashed with ISIS terrorist elements in Kirkuk province northern Iraq; one terrorist killed as initial toll. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83435)
A drone fell near the Iraqi-Kuwaiti border per Iraqi monitoring channel report. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378056)
U.S. American radar targets between Kuwait border and naval base were struck per Iraqi monitoring channel. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378062)
Iranian heavy shelling targeted the road used by mobile U.S. rocket launch platforms per Iraqi channel. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83466)
Fires ignited in U.S. military equipment on Kuwaiti lands near Iraqi border after rocket and suicide drone attack per Iraqi channel. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83456)
Smoke columns rose in Kuwait resulting from recent Iranian attack on mobile U.S. platforms per Iraqi channel. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83467)
Reports of explosion sounds in Dubai were published by Yedioth news channel without further detail. (Source: @yediotnews25/132793)
U.S. forces attacked and disabled the Curaçao-flagged tanker M/T Belma near Kharg Island after U.S. blockade on Iranian ports; fuel spill seen via satellite. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5025)
U.S. MQ-9 drone downed over Khuzestan and U.S. strikes on Hormozgan bridges caused Kuwait-adjacent fires per related Gulf monitoring. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93631)
Houthis in Yemen completed preparations to attack ships with missiles and drones at Bab al-Mandeb with IRGC in Yemen to decide closure. (Source: @asafroz/51524)
Iranian threat to open new fronts if hostile acts continue may implicate Gulf shipping and U.S. assets in the region. (Source: @inon_yttach/9495)
No explicit Gulf state government response beyond reported explosions and U.S. tanker action was stated in messages. (Source: @yediotnews25/132793)

sections.threat_assessment: U.S. strikes on Iran now span six nights with targets including Hormozgan bridges, Bandar Abbas rail and residential areas, and Khuzestan blasts, indicating widening campaign scope. Iran warns continued hostility opens new fronts and Houthis are prepared to close Bab al-Mandeb with IRGC decision authority, risking global shipping. Israeli operations in Gaza continue eliminating Hamas commanders while Israel maintains security zones in Syria, Gaza, Lebanon against jihadist threats. Syrian interdiction of Hezbollah-bound drones and missiles shows active arms blockade; Iraqi border sees U.S.-Iran proxy fires near Kuwait.
sections.regional_response: Israeli Defense Minister Katz coordinated with U.S. Secretary Hegseth on Iran operations and reaffirmed bilateral cooperation and border security zones. Houthis in Yemen took Iranian orders to potentially block Bab al-Mandeb if U.S. hits Iranian power stations, escalating maritime risk. Syria intercepted a major Hezbollah-bound arms shipment at the Iraq border, while Iraqi channels report Iranian strikes on U.S. mobile platforms and fires on Kuwaiti-adjacent U.S. equipment. Thousands rallied in Tehran supporting armed forces per Press TV.
sections.intelligence_notes: Messages show a multi-theater escalation: U.S. air campaign against Iran, Israeli targeted killings in Gaza, and Lebanon southern spike in drone/artillery events. Iranian air defense downed an MQ-9 over Khuzestan, suggesting improved intercept capability. Curaçao-flagged M/T Belma disabled near Kharg Island shows U.S. blockade enforcement with environmental spill. Syrian seizure of 150 explosive drones and missiles in oil tankers is significant Hezbollah supply disruption. Open-source claims lack casualty verification in some Iran strikes beyond Press TV and provincial reports.
